name: login-03
title: Login 03
description: A card on a quiet desk with a pencil lying about. Apple and Google buttons, an or-continue-with rule, then email and password. The desk is the muted background of the official block and travels with the block.
docs:
Installed the "Login 03" block into your components directory under blocks/login-03/.
Import it: import Login03Page from "<your components alias>/blocks/login-03/page"
Needs @hookform/resolvers@^5, react-hook-form@^7, zod@^4: the CLI installs them (a project on an older major is upgraded).
